children: Solmate Infrastructure PLC (NASDAQ: SLMT) ("Solmate" or the "Company") today announced the appointment of Yaffa Cohen-Ifrah as Chief Marketing Officer and Head of Investor Relations. She will lead the Company's global marketing, brand and investor relations. Ms. Cohen-Ifrah will be based in New York.

The appointment follows a strong period for the Company's SOL treasury. According to Solmate's public treasury dashboard, the estimated market value of the Company's SOL holdings was approximately $146.7 million as of September 21, 2026, up from approximately $88 million in July 2026, an increase of approximately 67%. The Company holds approximately 1.24 million SOL. These amounts are unrealized and reflect movements in the market price of SOL; the Company has not sold any SOL, and the value of its holdings may decline substantially.

Ms. Cohen-Ifrah brings more than 25 years of global marketing and investor relations leadership. Most recently, she served as Chief Marketing Officer and Head of Investor Relations of Sapiens, a Nasdaq-listed global software company. There, she led the investor relations function through a major private equity transaction while driving global go-to-market execution, demand generation, and brand transformation to accelerate commercial growth. As a member of the Executive Leadership Team at Sapiens, she directed overall corporate marketing strategy to align category positioning with revenue growth while managing all capital markets communications, including quarterly earnings, annual reporting, and Investor Days. She developed the core equity narrative and executed a global investor targeting strategy that significantly expanded the company’s institutional shareholder base across North America.

Before that, she was Chief Marketing Officer of Vitech Systems Group, and earlier Chief Marketing Officer and Head of Corporate Communications of Sapiens. She has also held senior roles at Strauss Group, ADAMA, Victoria's Secret and Saks Fifth Avenue. Ms. Cohen-Ifrah holds a BSc in Biology from Tel Aviv University and an MBA in Finance and Marketing from Pace University in New York.

At Solmate, Ms. Cohen-Ifrah will lead investor communications and outreach, including the Company's upcoming investor events, and will build the Solmate brand as the Company expands its digital infrastructure business.

"The value of our SOL treasury has grown, and the market is starting to take notice. Now we need to tell our story to investors with the same discipline we apply to building the treasury," said Ron Sade, Chief Executive Officer of Solmate. "Yaffa has done exactly that for a Nasdaq-listed company on a global stage: she sharpened the story, broadened the shareholder base and built lasting relationships with institutional investors. We are delighted to welcome her to Solmate."
